AcceptanceDecision.description:
The decision produced by the acceptance policy.

``policy_version`` ties the decision to the exact policy text that
produced it so we can reproduce historic decisions after policy
upgrades.
AcceptanceDecision.title: AcceptanceDecision

ActivityValue.description:
The structured representation of an activity value.

``kind`` discriminates how ``number``/``lower``/``upper``/``uncertainty``
are interpreted. ``raw`` always retains the original string from the
source so reviewers can audit the parse.
ActivityValue.title: ActivityValue

ArtifactRef.description:
A reference to an immutable artifact on disk.

``relative_path`` is anchored at the configured ``artifact_root`` and
must not contain ``..`` segments or absolute paths. The same path with
a different ``sha256`` is reported as :data:`ARTIFACT_CONFLICT`.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

CheckResult.description:
A single structured check on a record.

The ``check_id`` mirrors the IDs in design §6.6. ``outcome`` is the
discrete result and ``evidence_ids`` points to the evidence that
triggered the decision. We deliberately keep ``details`` as a free-form
string dict so future checks can attach operator-specific notes without
schema churn.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

PageGeometry.description:
Page dimensions in PDF points after rotation/CropBox has been applied.

The width/height are expressed in the user-facing (visible) coordinate
system. Downstream geometry maths MUST rely on these values, never on
the raw MediaBox.
PageGeometry.title: PageGeometry

DocumentInspection.description:
The result of the ingestion inspector.

Carries the SHA-256 of the original bytes (used as ``document_id``),
the page geometry list and encryption flags. Parsers must never see
raw bytes they have not first verified.
DocumentInspection.title: DocumentInspection

EvidenceSpan.description:
A location reference for an extracted value or statement.

The ``bbox`` field is optional because some upstream sources (e.g. an
OCR-only PDF, or a continuation cell without its own coordinates) only
know the page. The contract distinguishes ``bbox is None`` from
``bbox is not None but page is None``.

anyOf.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points). Origin is bottom-left; x0 <= x1, y0 <= y1.

EvidenceSpan.title: EvidenceSpan

EvidenceBundle.description:
A collection of :class:`EvidenceSpan` records.

Centralises the per-document evidence index so domain rules and
validators can pull all spans for a job without re-reading artifact
files.
EvidenceBundle.title: EvidenceBundle

EvidenceImage.description:
A rendered PNG tied back to the page coordinates it was clipped from.

``transform_to_page`` describes the affine used to go from image pixels
back to PDF points; it is stored separately from ``bbox`` because the
rendered image may have been clipped, scaled or de-skewed.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points). Origin is bottom-left; x0 <= x1, y0 <= y1.
bbox.title: Bbox

EvidenceImage.title: EvidenceImage

EvidenceRef.description:
A reference to an :class:`EvidenceSpan` from a record.

Records may share evidence (e.g. a measurement and its row header).
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

EvidenceSpan.description:
A location reference for an extracted value or statement.

The ``bbox`` field is optional because some upstream sources (e.g. an
OCR-only PDF, or a continuation cell without its own coordinates) only
know the page. The contract distinguishes ``bbox is None`` from
``bbox is not None but page is None``.

anyOf.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points). Origin is bottom-left; x0 <= x1, y0 <= y1.

EvidenceSpan.title: EvidenceSpan

Job.description:
A parse/extract job.

The same ``document_id`` may have many ``Job`` rows over its history
(different configs, retries). ``result_revision`` increments whenever
the runner produces a new export revision.
Job.title: Job

source so reviewers can audit the parse.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult

Measurement.description:
A measurement linking an entity to a value with evidence.

Field-level evidence is required for ``value``/``unit``/``entity``/
``target`` so that reviewers can audit which cell or paragraph
contributed each component.
Measurement.title: Measurement

Provenance.description: One source-of-truth link back to an upstream artifact.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Table.description:
A normalised table.

``header_cell_ids`` keeps the linkage to the cells acting as the
column/row headers so evidence can travel with each measurement.

anyOf.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points). Origin is bottom-left; x0 <= x1, y0 <= y1.

Table.title: Table

TableCell.description:
A cell inside a normalised table.

``row_index``/``column_index`` are zero-based. ``rowspan``/``colspan``
follow the HTML convention (both default to 1).

anyOf.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points). Origin is bottom-left; x0 <= x1, y0 <= y1.

TableCell.title: TableCell

TextBlock.description:
A single block on a normalised page.

Blocks are the atom the domain rules consume. ``bbox`` may be ``None``
if the upstream source could not produce coordinates (e.g. an OCR page
that returned text only). ``kind`` separates sequence listings from
regular prose so downstream extractors can dispatch cheaply.

anyOf.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points). Origin is bottom-left; x0 <= x1, y0 <= y1.

TextBlock.title: TextBlock

NormalizedDocument.description:
The unified parser output.

Produced by every adapter (native, Docling, MinerU). Domain code never
sees the SDK-specific objects directly.
NormalizedDocument.title: NormalizedDocument

Provenance.description: One source-of-truth link back to an upstream artifact.
Provenance.title: Provenance

PageQuality.description:
Per-page quality signals.

``image_coverage`` is the union of image area over the visible page
area; the design forbids naïve sum-based coverage that can exceed 1.0.
PageQuality.title: PageQuality

Provenance.description: One source-of-truth link back to an upstream artifact.
Provenance.title: Provenance

QualityConfig.description:
Thresholds used by the page-quality classifier.

The defaults mirror ``configs/demo.toml`` and are deliberately
conservative. Tune after we have real-sample coverage.
QualityConfig.title: QualityConfig

ReviewDecision.description:
A human-issued decision appended to a review item.

``patch_json`` is the field-level correction when ``action='correct'``.
``base_revision`` ensures decisions cannot be silently applied to a
record that has since changed.
ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

RouteDecision.description:
The routing decision for a page.

``reasons`` carries the human-readable rationale (referencing the
signal values) and ``rule_version`` pins the classifier so reviewers
know which version of the rule produced the decision.
RouteDecision.title: RouteDecision

CheckResult.description:
A single structured check on a record.

The ``check_id`` mirrors the IDs in design §6.6. ``outcome`` is the

triggered the decision. We deliberately keep ``details`` as a free-form
string dict so future checks can attach operator-specific notes without
schema churn.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

SequenceRecord.description:
A sequence candidate extracted from a page.

The record carries both the original raw form (e.g. ST.25 three-letter
blocks) and the normalized one-letter form. ``declared_length`` and
``observed_length`` are stored independently so incomplete trailing
segments remain honest.
SequenceRecord.title: SequenceRecord

SequenceReference.description:
A SEQ ID mention that has not been resolved to a sequence.

Resolved references keep the same shape but set ``resolved_sequence_id``
to the linked :class:`SequenceRecord`.
SequenceReference.title: SequenceReference

SequenceRelation.description:
An explicit relation between two records or entities.

``predicate`` controls the semantic; cross-language consumers must
accept the exact set in :data:`RelationPredicate`.
SequenceRelation.title: SequenceRelation

Stage.description:
One persisted stage execution.

``cache_key`` lets the runner skip re-running a stage whose inputs and
rules have not changed. ``attempt`` counts from 1.
Stage.title: Stage

ArtifactRef.description:
A reference to an immutable artifact on disk.

``relative_path`` is anchored at the configured ``artifact_root`` and
must not contain ``..`` segments or absolute paths. The same path with
a different ``sha256`` is reported as :data:`ARTIFACT_CONFLICT`.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

StageOutcome.description:
The return value of a stage handler.

``review_required`` is a *count* of records the runner should add to
the review queue, not a guarantee.
StageOutcome.title: StageOutcome

ValidationResult.description:
The aggregate of a record's checks.

``review_reasons`` capture rationale beyond the structured checks so the
review UI can present actionable guidance.
